Row.Text: "Sing of Ishtar, most formidable of goddesses! May she be honored, queen of all beings, greatest of the Igigi. Her lips are sweet as honey, her mouth is life."
"The produce of mountains, the fullness of seas - a rich present, a splendid gift, to my City of Babylon."
"O god Marduk, you are our avenger. Your weapon will never miss its mark, but it will break your enemies."
"Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?"
